exact_claim: If A is the claimed normal integral finite-type complex surface algebra with globally free rank-two derivations and a nonregular maximal localization, then kappa_bar((Spec A)_reg)=2.

claim_assessments.reason: The global algebraic frame restricts to a trivial tangent bundle on the smooth locus. The exact v1 Theorem 0.1(1) would force smoothness if logarithmic Kodaira dimension were <=1, including -infinity. Its remaining possible surface value is 2. This depends on the main surface existing.

external_assumptions.statement: Over an algebraically closed field of characteristic zero, an affine algebraic surface whose smooth locus has trivial tangent bundle and logarithmic Kodaira dimension <=1 is smooth.
